--!strict
-- Ready-cash ledger, retaining old queue/upgrade fields for save compatibility.
local Config = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared.EggProcessorConfig)
local Processor = {}

function Processor.New()
	return {level = 0, batches = {}, readyValue = 0, progress = 0, finishCredits = 0}
end

function Processor.Copy(state)
	local copy = table.clone(state)
	copy.batches = {}
	for _, batch in state.batches do table.insert(copy.batches, table.clone(batch)) end
	return copy
end

function Processor.Totals(state)
	local count, value = 0, 0
	for _, batch in state.batches do count += batch.count; value += batch.value end
	return count, value
end

function Processor.Read(data)
	if data == nil then return Processor.New() end
	local function valid(n, max)
		return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 0 and n <= max and n % 1 == 0
	end
	if type(data) ~= "table" or not valid(data.level, #Config.Prices)
		or not valid(data.readyValue, Config.MaxValue) or not valid(data.finishCredits, 1e9)
		or type(data.progress) ~= "number" or data.progress ~= data.progress or data.progress < 0 or data.progress >= 1
		or type(data.batches) ~= "table" or #data.batches > Config.MaxBatches then return nil end
	local state = Processor.New()
	state.level, state.readyValue, state.progress, state.finishCredits = data.level, data.readyValue, data.progress, data.finishCredits
	local entries, count, value = 0, 0, state.readyValue
	for key, batch in data.batches do
		if not valid(key, #data.batches) or key < 1 or type(batch) ~= "table"
			or not valid(batch.count, Config.MaxValue) or batch.count < 1 or not valid(batch.value, Config.MaxValue) then return nil end
		entries += 1; count += batch.count; value += batch.value
		if count > Config.MaxValue or value > Config.MaxValue then return nil end
		state.batches[key] = {count = batch.count, value = batch.value}
	end
	if entries ~= #data.batches then return nil end
	return state
end

function Processor.Finish(state)
	local count, value = Processor.Totals(state)
	state.readyValue += value
	table.clear(state.batches)
	state.progress = 0
	return count
end

function Processor.Deposit(state, count, value)
	local oldCount, oldValue = Processor.Totals(state)
	if type(count) ~= "number" or count ~= count or count % 1 ~= 0
		or type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value or value % 1 ~= 0
		or count < 1 or value < 1 or oldCount + count > Config.MaxValue
		or oldValue + state.readyValue + value > Config.MaxValue then return false end
	-- Convert the entire batch at deposit, including any legacy queued balance.
	Processor.Finish(state)
	state.readyValue += value
	return true
end

function Processor.GrantFinish(state)
	-- Old receipts create a durable compensation credit. PlayerSession owns its
	-- exact cash settlement; retaining the counter also handles a full wallet.
	if state.finishCredits >= 1e9 then return false end
	state.finishCredits += 1
	return true
end

return Processor

--!strict
-- Server-owned pickup ledger. Authored plots carry eggs until their sell pad is reached.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Shared=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared
local Config=require(Shared.Config)
local Rules=require(Shared.Rules)
local VacuumConfig=require(Shared.VacuumConfig)
local Layout=require(Shared.HomePlotLayout)
local ShopCatalog=require(Shared.ShopCatalog)
local EggRover=require(script.Parent.EggRover)
local Processor=require(script.Parent.EggProcessor)
local ProcessorConfig=require(Shared.EggProcessorConfig)
local EggService={}
EggService.__index=EggService
local CASH_COLLECT_SECONDS=1
local CASH_MIN_HORIZONTAL_SPEED=0.5 -- Ignore standing jitter and vertical pad travel.

local function onCashPad(pad,position)
 if not position or not pad or not pad:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
 local at=pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
 return math.abs(at.X)<=pad.Size.X/2+0.7 and math.abs(at.Z)<=pad.Size.Z/2+0.7
  and at.Y>=-1 and at.Y<=pad.Size.Y/2+5
end

function EggService.new(world)
 return setmetatable({world=world,yards={},serial=0,generation=0},EggService)
end

function EggService:Board(session)
 local root=self.world.root
 if not root then return nil end
 local board=root:FindFirstChild("EggCollectionBoard")
 if board and board:GetAttribute("PlotIndex")==session.plotIndex then return board end
 local plot=self.world.plots[session.plotIndex]
 return plot and plot.folder:FindFirstChild("EggCollectionBoard",true)
end

function EggService:Upgrade(_player,_session,_level,_price)
 -- Stale clients must never spend cash on the retired track.
 return false,"Eggs now sell instantly. Selling Speed is no longer needed."
end

function EggService:AcceptDeposit(session,count,value)
 if not Processor.Deposit(session.eggProcessor,count,value) then return false end
 session:Touch()
 -- The old queued receipt flag means transferred to the collector rather than
 -- paid to the wallet. Conversion itself is immediate on every plot.
 return true,0,true
end

function EggService:ProcessAndClaim(session,position,_dt,now,grounded,velocity)
 -- Also retries any legacy compensation held while the wallet was full.
 session:RetireEggSeller()
 local board=self:Board(session)
 local collection=board and board:FindFirstChild("CollectionPart")
 local pad=collection and collection:FindFirstChild("TouchPart")
 -- An unavailable board must not strand earned cash; retain the owned-pad fallback.
 if not board then
  local fallback,owner=self.world:EggDeposit(session.plotIndex)
  if owner==session.userId then pad=fallback end
 end
 -- Every payout requires current horizontal movement, not merely pad occupancy.
 -- Read replicated root velocity on the server; client MoveDirection is not the grant authority.
 if grounded~=true or not onCashPad(pad,position) then return end
 if not velocity or not (velocity.X^2+velocity.Z^2>CASH_MIN_HORIZONTAL_SPEED^2) then return end
 self:ClaimReady(session,pad,now)
end

function EggService:ClaimReady(session,pad,now)
 local state=session.eggProcessor
 local yard=self:Yard(session)
 -- Only the server's current ready balance can be paid; repeated requests cannot duplicate it.
 if state.readyValue<=0 or now-(yard.lastCashClaimAt or -math.huge)+1e-9<CASH_COLLECT_SECONDS then return false end
 local amount=session:EarnedAmount(state.readyValue,"eggs")
 if session.coins+amount>ProcessorConfig.MaxValue then return false end
 local raw=state.readyValue;state.readyValue=0
 local credited=session:Credit(raw,"eggs")
 yard.lastCashClaimAt=now
 session.tutorial.soldEggs=true
 yard.cashSerial=(yard.cashSerial or 0)+1
 yard.cashClaim={id=yard.generation..":"..yard.cashSerial,value=credited,at=now,
  x=pad.Position.X,y=pad.Position.Y+1,z=pad.Position.Z}
 return true
end

function EggService:Yard(session)
 local yard=self.yards[session.userId]
 -- Debug reset replaces the pet table; old eggs must not pay into a fresh test.
 if not yard or yard.pets~=session.pets then
  self.generation+=1
  yard={pets=session.pets,layers={},drops={},receipts={},revision=0,ordinal=0,generation=self.generation}
  self.yards[session.userId]=yard
 end
 return yard
end

function EggService:Lay(session,yard,petId,layer,now)
 local quantity,value=layer.count,layer.value
 if quantity<1 then return end
 local count,existing=0,nil
 for _,drop in yard.drops do
  if drop.petId==petId and not drop.claimAt then count+=1;existing=drop end
 end
 -- A visual represents an exact quantity of identical eggs. Work is bounded by
 -- drop count, even when one chicken produces hundreds of thousands per second.
 if count>=Config.EggsPerChicken or #yard.drops>=Config.EggMaxDrops then
  if not existing then for _,drop in yard.drops do if not drop.claimAt then existing=drop;break end end end
  if existing then
   existing.value+=value;existing.stack+=quantity;yard.revision+=1
   layer.count,layer.value=0,0
   return
  end
  -- All available stacks are in flight; retain their next quantity and value.
  return
 end
 local pet=session.pets[petId]
 local origin=self.world:PetPosition(session.plotIndex,petId)
  or self.world:ReturnPosition(session,petId,layer.ordinal)
 local frame=self.world:PlotFrame(session.plotIndex)
 local localAt=frame:PointToObjectSpace(origin)
 local layout=Layout.ForPlot(session.plotIndex)
 self.serial+=1
 local angle=self.serial*2.399963
 local position=(frame*CFrame.new(
  math.clamp(localAt.X+math.cos(angle)*2.2,layout.YardMinX,layout.YardMaxX),
  layout.FootY,math.clamp(localAt.Z+math.sin(angle)*2.2,layout.YardMinZ,layout.YardMaxZ))).Position
 table.insert(yard.drops,{id=tostring(self.serial),petId=petId,species=pet.species,
  x=position.X,y=position.Y,z=position.Z,originX=origin.X,originY=origin.Y+0.8,originZ=origin.Z,
  value=value,stack=quantity,born=now,readyAt=now+Config.EggSettleSeconds})
 layer.count,layer.value=0,0
 yard.revision+=1
end

function EggService:Produce(session,dt,now)
 local yard=self:Yard(session)
 local production=session:EggProductionMultiplier()
 local unitValue=Rules.EggUnitValue(session.incomeLevel)
 for id,pet in session.pets do
  local layer=yard.layers[id]
  if not layer then
   yard.ordinal+=1
   layer={count=0,value=0,fraction=0,elapsed=0,ordinal=yard.ordinal}
   yard.layers[id]=layer
  end
  if not session:IsPetHome(id) then continue end
  -- Speed changes affect future production only; partial eggs survive upgrades
  -- and time away. Price each completed egg once, at the shared current value.
  local accrued=layer.fraction+Rules.EggRate(pet.species,pet.stars,pet.level)*production*dt
  local quantity=math.floor(accrued+1e-7)
  layer.fraction=math.max(0,accrued-quantity)
  layer.count+=quantity;layer.value+=quantity*unitValue
  layer.elapsed+=dt
  if layer.count>0 and layer.elapsed+1e-7>=Config.EggVisualBatchSeconds then
   layer.elapsed=0
   self:Lay(session,yard,id,layer,now)
  end
 end
 for id in yard.layers do if not session.pets[id] then yard.layers[id]=nil end end
end

function EggService:Pay(session,yard,drop,now)
 if drop.paid then return end
 drop.paid=true
 local credited=session:EarnedAmount(drop.value,"eggs")
 if drop.collector=="rover" then
  local rover=yard.rover
  if rover and rover.enabled then
   rover.pendingCount=math.max(0,rover.pendingCount-(drop.stack or 1))
   rover.cargoCount+=drop.stack or 1
   rover.cargoValue+=drop.value
  else
   -- A claim already belongs to this player, even if the robot was toggled off.
   session.eggCarry.count+=drop.stack or 1
   session.eggCarry.value+=drop.value
   session:Touch()
  end
 else
  session.eggCarry.count+=drop.stack or 1
  session.eggCarry.value+=drop.value
  session:Touch()
 end
 session.tutorial.collectedEggs=true
 table.insert(yard.receipts,{id=drop.id,value=credited,count=drop.stack or 1,at=now,
  collector=drop.collector or "player",targetX=drop.targetX,targetY=drop.targetY,targetZ=drop.targetZ})
 yard.revision+=1
end

function EggService:RecordDeposit(yard,count,credited,now,collector,position,queued)
 yard.depositSerial=(yard.depositSerial or 0)+1
 yard.deposit={id=yard.generation..":"..yard.depositSerial,count=count,value=credited,at=now,
  collector=collector,queued=queued,targetX=position and position.X,targetY=position and position.Y,targetZ=position and position.Z}
 yard.revision+=1
end

function EggService:Deposit(session,position,now)
 if not session.loaded or session.closing or session.saveLost or not position then return false end
 local pad,ownerId=self.world:EggDeposit(session.plotIndex)
 if not pad or ownerId~=session.userId then return false end
 local at=pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
 if math.abs(at.X)>pad.Size.X/2+0.7 or math.abs(at.Z)>pad.Size.Z/2+0.7
  or at.Y< -1 or at.Y>pad.Size.Y/2+5 then return false end
 local carry=session.eggCarry
 if carry.value<=0 then return false end
 local count,value=carry.count,carry.value
 -- No yield between ledger transfer and clearing the bag.
 local accepted,credited,queued=self:AcceptDeposit(session,count,value)
 if not accepted then return false end
 session.eggCarry={count=0,value=0}
 session:Touch()
 if not queued then session.tutorial.soldEggs=true end
 local yard=self:Yard(session)
 self:RecordDeposit(yard,count,credited,now,"player",pad.Position,queued)
 return true,credited
end

function EggService:SettleClaims(session,yard,now,roverOnly,forceAll)
 for i=#yard.drops,1,-1 do
  local drop=yard.drops[i]
  if drop.claimAt and (forceAll or (if roverOnly then drop.collector=="rover" else now>=drop.claimAt+Config.EggFlightSeconds)) then
   self:Pay(session,yard,drop,now);table.remove(yard.drops,i)
  end
 end
end

function EggService:PreserveCargo(session,yard,now)
 local rover=yard.rover
 if not rover then return end
 -- Finish earned claims while this rover still owns them, then transfer once.
 self:SettleClaims(session,yard,now,true)
 if rover.cargoCount>0 or rover.cargoValue>0 then
  session.eggCarry.count+=rover.cargoCount
  session.eggCarry.value+=rover.cargoValue
  rover.cargoCount,rover.cargoValue=0,0
  session:Touch()
 end
 rover.enabled=false
 yard.revision+=1
end

function EggService:UpdateRover(session,yard,dt,now)
 local pad,ownerId=self.world:EggDeposit(session.plotIndex)
 local enabled=session:AutomaticEnabled("AutoCollectEggs")
  or (RunService:IsStudio() and session.commerceTestPreset==nil
   and workspace:GetAttribute(VacuumConfig.StudioTestAttribute)==true)
 enabled=enabled and pad~=nil and pad:IsA("BasePart") and ownerId==session.userId
 if not enabled then
  if yard.rover and yard.rover.enabled then self:PreserveCargo(session,yard,now) end
  return
 end
 -- Resize the next empty sweep, not a rover carrying earned eggs or in-flight claims.
 if yard.rover and yard.rover.enabled and yard.roverPlotSize~=session.plotSizeLevel
  and yard.rover.state=="Idle" and yard.rover.cargoCount==0 and yard.rover.pendingCount==0 then
  yard.rover=nil
 end
 if not yard.rover or not yard.rover.enabled then
  yard.roverSerial=(yard.roverSerial or 0)+1
  yard.roverPlotSize=session.plotSizeLevel
  yard.rover=EggRover.new(session.userId..":"..yard.generation..":"..yard.roverSerial,
   self.world:PlotFrame(session.plotIndex),session.plotIndex,pad,now)
 end
 local rover=yard.rover
 local hasEggs=false
 for _,drop in yard.drops do
  if not drop.claimAt and now>=drop.readyAt then hasEggs=true;break end
 end
 rover:Step(dt,now,hasEggs)
 -- Send the latest nozzle as a fallback for late packets or a removed model.
 local nozzle=rover:Nozzle()
 for _,drop in yard.drops do
  if drop.collector=="rover" and drop.claimAt then
   drop.targetX,drop.targetY,drop.targetZ=nozzle.X,nozzle.Y,nozzle.Z
  end
 end
 if rover:ReadyToUnload(now) then
  -- Recheck the owner's physical input pad at the payment boundary. The rover
  -- cannot sell remotely simply because its state says it reached a dock.
  local localAt=pad.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(rover.position)
  local atPad=math.abs(localAt.X)<=pad.Size.X/2+0.7 and math.abs(localAt.Z)<=pad.Size.Z/2+0.7
   and math.abs(localAt.Y)<=pad.Size.Y/2+5
  if not atPad then return end
  local count,value=rover.cargoCount,rover.cargoValue
  if value>0 then
   local accepted,credited,queued=self:AcceptDeposit(session,count,value)
   if not accepted then return end
   if not queued then session.tutorial.soldEggs=true end
   self:RecordDeposit(yard,count,credited,now,"rover",rover.position,queued)
  end
  rover.cargoCount,rover.cargoValue=0,0
  rover:FinishUnload(now)
 end
end

function EggService:Claim(yard,drop,now,collector,target)
 if drop.claimAt then return false end
 drop.claimAt=now;drop.collector=collector
 drop.targetX,drop.targetY,drop.targetZ=target.X,target.Y,target.Z
 yard.revision+=1
 if collector=="rover" then
  yard.rover.pendingCount+=drop.stack or 1
  yard.rover.suctionSerial+=1
 end
 return true
end

function EggService:Collect(session,position,now)
 local yard=self:Yard(session)
 if position then
  local near={}
  local radius=Config.EggMagnetRadius*(if session.entitlements and session.entitlements.EggMagnet==true then ShopCatalog.RadiusMultiplier else 1)
  for _,drop in yard.drops do
   if not drop.claimAt and now>=drop.readyAt then
    local distance=(position-Vector3.new(drop.x,drop.y+0.8,drop.z)).Magnitude
    if distance<=radius then table.insert(near,{drop=drop,distance=distance}) end
   end
  end
  table.sort(near,function(a,b)return a.distance<b.distance end)
  for i=1,math.min(Config.EggPickupBatch,#near) do
   self:Claim(yard,near[i].drop,now+(i-1)*0.06,"player",position+Vector3.new(0,-0.25,0))
  end
 end
 local rover=yard.rover
 if rover and rover.enabled and rover:CanCollect(now) then
  local nozzle=rover:Nozzle()
  local near={}
  for _,drop in yard.drops do
   if not drop.claimAt and now>=drop.readyAt then
    local distance=(nozzle-Vector3.new(drop.x,drop.y+0.8,drop.z)).Magnitude
    if distance<=rover.suctionRadius then table.insert(near,{drop=drop,distance=distance}) end
   end
  end
  table.sort(near,function(a,b)return a.distance<b.distance end)
  for i=1,math.min(VacuumConfig.PickupBatch,#near) do
   self:Claim(yard,near[i].drop,now+(i-1)*VacuumConfig.PickupStagger,"rover",nozzle)
  end
 end
 for i=#yard.receipts,1,-1 do if now-yard.receipts[i].at>3 then table.remove(yard.receipts,i) end end
end

function EggService:Step(sessions,dt,now)
 for _,session in sessions do
  if not session.loaded or session.closing or session.saveLost then continue end
  self:Produce(session,dt,now)
  local yard=self:Yard(session)
  self:SettleClaims(session,yard,now,false)
  self:UpdateRover(session,yard,dt,now)
  local player=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(session.userId)
  local character=player and player.Character
  local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local position=if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 then root.Position else nil
  self:Collect(session,position,now)
  self:Deposit(session,position,now)
  local grounded=humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0 and not humanoid.Jump and not humanoid.Sit
   and not humanoid.PlatformStand and humanoid.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air
  self:ProcessAndClaim(session,position,dt,now,grounded,root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
 end
end

function EggService:Snapshot(session,now)
 local yard=self:Yard(session)
 local drops,receipts={},{}
 local value,count=0,0
 for _,drop in yard.drops do
  local copy=table.clone(drop)
  copy.value=session:EarnedAmount(drop.value,"eggs")
  copy.age=math.max(0,now-drop.born)
  copy.flightAge=if drop.claimAt then now-drop.claimAt else nil
  copy.born,copy.readyAt,copy.claimAt=nil,nil,nil
  table.insert(drops,copy);value+=copy.value;count+=copy.stack
 end
 for _,receipt in yard.receipts do
  local copy=table.clone(receipt);copy.at=nil;table.insert(receipts,copy)
 end
 local deposit=if yard.deposit and now-yard.deposit.at<3 then table.clone(yard.deposit) else nil
 if deposit then deposit.at=nil end
 local processor=session.eggProcessor
 local cashClaim=if yard.cashClaim and now-yard.cashClaim.at<3 then table.clone(yard.cashClaim) else nil
 if cashClaim then cashClaim.at=nil end
 return {revision=yard.revision,generation=yard.generation,drops=drops,receipts=receipts,value=value,count=count,
  processor={enabled=true,instant=true,queuedCount=0,
   readyCash=session:EarnedAmount(processor.readyValue,"eggs")},cashClaim=cashClaim,
  requiresDeposit=true,carriedCount=session.eggCarry.count,
  carriedValue=session:EarnedAmount(session.eggCarry.value,"eggs"),deposit=deposit,
  rover=if yard.rover then yard.rover:Snapshot(session) else {enabled=false}}
end

function EggService:Release(session)
 local yard=self.yards[session.userId]
 if not yard then return end
 -- A proximity-claimed pickup is already earned even if the player leaves mid-flight.
 if not session.saveLost then
  local now=os.clock()
  self:SettleClaims(session,yard,now,false,true)
  self:PreserveCargo(session,yard,now)
 end
 self.yards[session.userId]=nil
end

function EggService:Destroy()
 table.clear(self.yards)
end
return EggService

--!strict
-- Offline cash calculation only. DataService owns the durable award boundary.
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared
local Rules = require(Shared.Rules)
local Tuning = require(Shared.OfflineCashConfig)
local OfflineCash = {}

function OfflineCash.Read(value)
	if value == nil then return {at = 0, rate = 0} end
	local function finite(n, maximum)
		return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= 0 and n <= maximum
	end
	if type(value) ~= "table" or not finite(value.at, 2^53 - 1) or value.at % 1 ~= 0
		or not finite(value.rate, Tuning.MaxCoins) then return nil end
	return {at = value.at, rate = value.rate}
end

function OfflineCash.Rate(session)
	-- All owned chickens return home between visits; quitting in battle must not
	-- permanently remove them from the next night's earning rate.
	local eggsPerSecond = 0
	for _, pet in session.pets do
		eggsPerSecond += Rules.EggRate(pet.species, pet.stars, pet.level)
	end
	eggsPerSecond *= session:EggProductionMultiplier()
	-- Use the existing income and pass owners. No extra multiplier at award time.
	local raw = eggsPerSecond * Rules.EggUnitValue(session.incomeLevel)
	return session:EarnedAmount(raw, "eggs") * Tuning.Efficiency
end

function OfflineCash.Reward(checkpoint, now, coins)
	local away = if checkpoint.at > 0 then math.max(0, now - checkpoint.at) else 0
	local counted = math.min(away, Tuning.MaxSeconds)
	local amount = if away >= Tuning.MinSeconds then math.floor(counted * checkpoint.rate + 1e-7) else 0
	amount = math.max(0, math.min(amount, math.floor(Tuning.MaxCoins - coins)))
	return {amount = amount, awaySeconds = away, countedSeconds = counted,
		rate = checkpoint.rate, efficiency = Tuning.Efficiency, maxSeconds = Tuning.MaxSeconds,
		capped = away > Tuning.MaxSeconds}
end

return OfflineCash

--!strict
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Rules = require(Shared.Rules)
local Catalog = require(Shared.PetCatalog)
local Progression = require(Shared.Progression)
local ShopCatalog = require(Shared.ShopCatalog)
local UpgradeCatalog = require(Shared.UpgradeCatalog)
local EggProcessor = require(script.Parent.EggProcessor)
local EggProcessorConfig = require(Shared.EggProcessorConfig)
local OfflineCash = require(script.Parent.OfflineCash)
local PlayerSession = {}
PlayerSession.__index = PlayerSession

function PlayerSession.new(userId: number, name: string, plotIndex: number)
	local self = setmetatable({}, PlayerSession)
	self.userId, self.name, self.plotIndex = userId, name, plotIndex
	self.revision = 0
	-- Verified by CommerceService per visit; never serialized or reset with coins.
	self.entitlements = {}
	self:Reset()
	return self
end

function PlayerSession:Reset()
	-- A debug gameplay reset must never re-deliver an acknowledged purchase.
	self.purchaseReceipts=self.purchaseReceipts or {}
	self.crateCredits=self.crateCredits or 0
	self.guaranteedLuckRolls=self.guaranteedLuckRolls or 0
	self.commerceAutomatic=self.commerceAutomatic or {AutoCollectEggs=true,AutoMerge=true}
	self.coins, self.capacity, self.luck = Config.StartingCoins, Config.StartingSlots, 0
	self.eggSpeedLevel, self.plotSizeLevel, self.rollSlotsUnlocked = 0, 0, 1
	self.eggCarry={count=0,value=0}
	self.offlineCash = {at=0,rate=0}
	self.offlineCashReceipt = nil
	local finishCredits = if self.eggProcessor then self.eggProcessor.finishCredits else 0
	self.eggProcessor = EggProcessor.New()
	self.eggProcessor.finishCredits = finishCredits
	self.enemyKills=0

 return UpgradeCatalog.EggSpeedRates[self.eggSpeedLevel + 1]

 return self.entitlements[key]==true and self.commerceAutomatic[key]==true

function PlayerSession:LuckGuarantee()
 local schedule=ShopCatalog.GuaranteedLuck
 local count=self.guaranteedLuckRolls
 local index=math.floor(count/schedule.interval)%#schedule.sequence+1
 return {interval=schedule.interval,rollsRemaining=schedule.interval-count%schedule.interval,
  nextSpecies=schedule.sequence[index],sequence=table.clone(schedule.sequence)}
end

function PlayerSession:AdvanceGuaranteedLuck(): string?
 if self.entitlements.DoubleLuck~=true or self.paidRandomRestricted~=true then return nil end
 local guarantee=self:LuckGuarantee()
 self.guaranteedLuckRolls=(self.guaranteedLuckRolls+1)%(guarantee.interval*#guarantee.sequence)
 return if guarantee.rollsRemaining==1 then guarantee.nextSpecies else nil
end

function PlayerSession:EarnedAmount(amount: number, source: string): number
 local earned=source=="eggs" or source=="battle" or source=="territory"
 return amount * (if earned and self.entitlements.DoubleCash then 2 else 1)
end

function PlayerSession:Count(): number
	local count = 0
	for _ in self.pets do count += 1 end
	return count
end

function PlayerSession:FindSlot(id: string): number?
	for slot, petId in self.slots do if petId == id then return slot end end
	return nil
end

-- Automatic combat-power ranking. Equal-power purchases preserve the existing squad.
function PlayerSession:AutoBestPetIds()
	local ranked={}
	for id,pet in self.pets do
		table.insert(ranked,{id=id,power=Rules.PetPower(pet.species,pet.stars,pet.level),slot=self:FindSlot(id)})
	end
	table.sort(ranked,function(a,b)
		if a.power~=b.power then return a.power>b.power end
		if (a.slot~=nil)~=(b.slot~=nil) then return a.slot~=nil end
		if a.slot and b.slot then return a.slot<b.slot end
		return a.id<b.id
	end)
	local ids={}
	for i=1,math.min(self:Capacity(),#ranked) do table.insert(ids,ranked[i].id) end
	return ids
end

-- Existing deployment/reinforcement consumers use this desired roster contract.
function PlayerSession:BestPetIds()
	if self.armySelection==nil then return self:AutoBestPetIds() end
	local ids,seen={},{}
	for _,id in self.armySelection do
		if self.pets[id] and not seen[id] and #ids<self:Capacity() then
			seen[id]=true;table.insert(ids,id)
		end
	end
	return ids
end

function PlayerSession:RefreshArmy(): boolean
	-- BattleService owns physical relief handoffs while deployed.
	if self:IsArmyLocked() then return false end
	local best=self:BestPetIds()
	local chosen,slots={},{}
	for _,id in best do chosen[id]=true end
	for slot,id in self.slots do
		if slot<=self:Capacity() and chosen[id] then slots[slot]=id end
	end
	for _,id in best do
		local oldSlot=self:FindSlot(id)
		if not oldSlot or slots[oldSlot]~=id then
			for slot=1,self:Capacity() do if not slots[slot] then slots[slot]=id;break end end
		end
	end
	-- Manual ordering is explicit; automatic mode retains the stable slot behavior above.
	if self.armySelection~=nil then slots=table.clone(best) end
	local changed=false
	for slot,id in self.slots do if slots[slot]~=id then changed=true;break end end
	if not changed then for slot,id in slots do if self.slots[slot]~=id then changed=true;break end end end
	if changed then self.slots=slots;self:Touch() end
	return changed
end

local function selectedSet(session)

local function saleEligibility(session,id,selected): (boolean,string)
	local pet=if type(id)=="string" then session.pets[id] else nil
	if not pet then return false,"That chicken is no longer in your flock." end
	if pet.favorite then return false,"Favorite protected — unfavorite this chicken before selling." end
	if not session:IsPetHome(id) then return false,"This chicken is deployed or traveling." end
	if selected[id] then return false,"Selected for your army. Remove this chicken from the army before selling." end
	return true,"Reserve chicken — available to sell."
end

end

function PlayerSession:Lineup()
	local result = {}
	for slot=1, self:Capacity() do
		local pet = self.pets[self.slots[slot]]
		if pet then table.insert(result, {id=pet.id, species=pet.species, stars=pet.stars, level=pet.level, slot=slot}) end
	end
	return result
end

-- Physical home location determines egg production.

-- until its departure, defense or recovery transition has finished.

end

function PlayerSession:HomePets()
	local result={}
	for id,pet in self.pets do if self:IsPetHome(id) then table.insert(result,pet) end end
	table.sort(result,function(a,b) return a.id<b.id end)
	return result
end

end

function PlayerSession:RetireEggSeller()
 local state=self.eggProcessor
 local finished=EggProcessor.Finish(state)>0
 local refund=0
 -- The remaining saved level represents exactly the purchases not refunded yet.
 while state.level>0 do
  local price=EggProcessorConfig.Prices[state.level]
  if self.coins+refund+price>EggProcessorConfig.MaxValue then break end
  refund+=price;state.level-=1
 end
 local compensation=ShopCatalog.Products.FinishEggs.retirementCoins
 local credits=math.min(state.finishCredits,math.floor(math.max(0,EggProcessorConfig.MaxValue-self.coins-refund)/compensation))
 state.finishCredits-=credits;refund+=credits*compensation
 -- Refunds and paid replacements are exact cash, never multiplied by 2x Cash.
 if refund>0 then self:Credit(refund,"refund") elseif finished then self:Touch() end
 return refund
end

function PlayerSession:Income(): number
	local income=0
	for id in self.pets do if self:IsPetHome(id) then income+=self:PetIncome(id) end end
	return income
end

function PlayerSession:Credit(amount: number, source: string)
	assert(type(amount)=="number" and amount==amount and amount>=0 and amount<math.huge and amount%1==0,"Coin credits must be nonnegative whole numbers")
	if amount==0 then return 0 end
	amount=self:EarnedAmount(amount,source)
	self.coins += amount
	if source == "eggs" then self.passiveEarned += amount end
	if source == "battle" then self.battleEarned += amount end
	-- Session-only observation totals; never serialized or used to authorize a purchase.
	self.sessionIncome=self.sessionIncome or {eggs=0,battle=0,territory=0}
	if self.sessionIncome[source]~=nil then self.sessionIncome[source]+=amount end
	self:Touch()
	return amount
end

 self:Touch()

	end

local function numberIn(value,minimum,maximum,integer)
 return type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=minimum and value<=maximum and (not integer or value%1==0)
end

local function readWins(entries, limit, sparse)
	if type(entries)~="table" or #entries>limit then return nil end
	local wins,count={},0
	for key,index in entries do
		count+=1
		if not numberIn(key,1,#entries,true) or not numberIn(index,1,limit,true) or wins[index] then return nil end
		wins[index]=true
	end
	if count~=#entries then return nil end
	local gap=false
	if not sparse then for i=1,limit do if not wins[i] then gap=true elseif gap then return nil end end end
	return wins
end

-- Revision 6 uses stable main-route IDs; appended camps can extend this list.
-- Earlier campaign layouts retain only IDs 1/2: their old third camp is not
-- the new Bucket Bastion and must never grant its first win.
local function readProgress(data, revision)
	if revision>=6 then return readWins(data.firstWins,#Progression.Camps(1)) end
 if revision>=4 then
  local old=readWins(data.firstWins,3)
  if not old then return nil end
  local wins={}
  for i=1,2 do if old[i] or (data.promotion or 1)>1 then wins[i]=true end end
  return wins
 end
	local selected=readWins(data.firstWins,5)
	if not selected or not numberIn(data.campaign,1,3,true)
		or type(data.campaignWins)~="table" or #data.campaignWins~=3 then return nil end
	local histories,count={},0
	for index,entries in data.campaignWins do
		count+=1
		if not numberIn(index,1,3,true) then return nil end
		histories[index]=readWins(entries,5)
		if not histories[index] then return nil end
	end
	if count~=3 then return nil end
	local unlocked=1
	for index=1,2 do if histories[index][5] then unlocked=index+1 else break end end
	if data.campaign>unlocked then return nil end
	for index=unlocked+1,3 do if next(histories[index]) then return nil end end
	for i=1,5 do if (selected[i]==true)~=(histories[data.campaign][i]==true) then return nil end end
	-- Keep only clears of the two retained route IDs from the old campaigns.
	local wins={}
	for current,previous in {1,2} do if histories[1][previous] then wins[current]=true end end
	return wins
end

function PlayerSession:LoadData(data)
	if type(data)~="table" then return false,"Invalid saved profile." end
	local receipts={}
 if data.purchaseReceipts~=nil then
  if type(data.purchaseReceipts)~="table" then return false,"Invalid purchase history." end
  for id,productId in data.purchaseReceipts do
   if type(id)~="string" or #id<1 or #id>256 or not utf8.len(id)
    or not numberIn(productId,1,2^53-1,true) then return false,"Invalid purchase history." end
   receipts[id]=productId
  end
 end
 if not numberIn(data.crateCredits or 0,0,1e9,true) then return false,"Invalid saved crate count." end
 if not numberIn(data.guaranteedLuckRolls or 0,0,1e12,true) then return false,"Invalid saved guaranteed-offer progress." end
 local automatic={AutoCollectEggs=true,AutoMerge=true}
 if data.commerceAutomatic~=nil then
  if type(data.commerceAutomatic)~="table" then return false,"Invalid automatic settings." end
  for key,value in data.commerceAutomatic do
   if automatic[key]==nil or type(value)~="boolean" then return false,"Invalid automatic settings." end
   automatic[key]=value
  end
 end
 local revision=data.dataRevision or 1
	if not numberIn(revision,1,Config.DataRevision,true) then return false,"Unsupported saved profile revision." end
	-- Additive fields: never reduce the six slots an existing profile already had.
	local eggSpeedLevel = if data.eggSpeedLevel == nil then 0 else data.eggSpeedLevel
	local plotSizeLevel = if data.plotSizeLevel == nil then 0 else data.plotSizeLevel
	local rollSlotsUnlocked = if data.rollSlotsUnlocked == nil then Config.RollSlotsUnlocked else data.rollSlotsUnlocked
	if not numberIn(eggSpeedLevel,0,#UpgradeCatalog.EggSpeedPrices,true)
		or not numberIn(plotSizeLevel,0,#UpgradeCatalog.PlotPrices,true)
		or not numberIn(rollSlotsUnlocked,1,Config.RollSlotsUnlocked,true) then
		return false,"Invalid saved board upgrades."
	end
	local legacy=revision==1
	-- New carried eggs are distinct from the already-converted revision-1 egg bag.
	local carry=data.eggCarry or {count=0,value=0}
	local processor=EggProcessor.Read(data.eggProcessor)
	if not processor then return false,"Invalid saved egg processor." end
	local offlineCash=OfflineCash.Read(data.offlineCash)
	if not offlineCash then return false,"Invalid saved offline cash." end
	if type(carry)~="table" or not numberIn(carry.count,0,1e12,true)
		or not numberIn(carry.value,0,1e12,true) or ((carry.count==0)~=(carry.value==0))
		or not numberIn(data.enemyKills or 0,0,1e12,true) then return false,"Invalid saved eggs or defeat count." end
	local promotion=if revision>=5 then data.promotion else 1
	local recruitTier=if revision>=5 then data.recruitTier else 1
	if not numberIn(promotion,1,Progression.Count(),true) or not numberIn(recruitTier,1,promotion,true) then
		return false,"Invalid saved promotion."
	end
	local capacity,grant=data.capacity,data.legacyCapacityGrant or 0
	if legacy then
		local mapped={[4]=6,[5]=6,[6]=6,[8]=12,[10]=12,[12]=12}
		capacity=if type(data.capacity)=="number" then mapped[data.capacity] else nil
		if not capacity then return false,"Invalid legacy deployment capacity." end
		grant=capacity
	elseif revision==2 then
		if not table.find({6,12,24},capacity) then return false,"Invalid previous deployment capacity." end
		if not numberIn(grant,0,12,true) or (grant~=0 and grant~=6 and grant~=12) then return false,"Invalid grandfathered capacity grant." end
	end
	-- Preserve the collection and balance; only deployed capacity is capped at ten.
	if revision<3 then capacity=math.min(capacity,Config.MaxSlots);grant=capacity end
	if not numberIn(grant,0,Config.MaxSlots,true) then return false,"Invalid capacity grant." end
	if not numberIn(data.coins,0,1e12) or not numberIn(capacity,Config.StartingSlots,Config.MaxSlots,true)
		or not table.find(Config.SlotLevels,capacity) or grant>capacity or not numberIn(data.luck,0,#Config.LuckPrices,true)
		or not numberIn(data.incomeLevel,0,#Config.IncomePrices,true) or type(data.pets)~="table" or #data.pets>Config.LegacyCollectionLimit
		or type(data.tutorial)~="table" then return false,"Invalid saved profile." end
	local converted=0
	if legacy then
		if not numberIn(data.eggBagCount or 0,0,1e12,true) or not numberIn(data.eggBagValue or 0,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved egg bag." end
		converted=data.eggBagValue or 0
	end
	local pets,count={},0
	for index,pet in data.pets do
		count+=1
		if not numberIn(index,1,#data.pets,true) or type(pet)~="table" or type(pet.id)~="string" or #pet.id<1 or #pet.id>64
			or not utf8.len(pet.id) or pets[pet.id] or type(pet.species)~="string" or not table.find(Catalog.Order,pet.species)
			or type(pet.favorite)~="boolean" or not numberIn(pet.collected or 0,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved chicken." end
		if legacy then
			if not numberIn(pet.cash or 0,0,1e10) or not numberIn(pet.eggCount or 0,0,1e6,true)
				or not numberIn(pet.eggTimer or 0,0,Config.LegacyEggLaySeconds) then return false,"Invalid saved egg value." end
			converted+=pet.cash or 0
		end
		local level=if revision<3 then 1 else pet.level
		if not numberIn(level,1,Config.MaxPetLevel,true) then return false,"Invalid saved chicken level." end
		local investment=if revision<5 then Rules.Investment(pet.species,level,true) else pet.investment
		if not numberIn(investment,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved chicken investment." end
		pets[pet.id]={id=pet.id,species=pet.species,stars=1,level=level,favorite=pet.favorite,collected=math.ceil(pet.collected or 0),investment=math.ceil(investment)}
	end
	if count~=#data.pets then return false,"Invalid saved collection." end
	-- Optional additive field; existing profiles continue selecting their best chickens.
	local armySelection
	if data.armySelection~=nil then
		if type(data.armySelection)~="table" or #data.armySelection>capacity+ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus then
			return false,"Invalid saved army selection."
		end
		local seen,entries={},0
		armySelection={}
		for index,id in data.armySelection do
			entries+=1
			if entries>capacity+ShopCatalog.ArmyBonus or not numberIn(index,1,#data.armySelection,true)
				or type(id)~="string" or not pets[id] or seen[id] then
				return false,"Invalid saved army selection."
			end
			seen[id]=true;armySelection[index]=id
		end
		if entries~=#data.armySelection then return false,"Invalid saved army selection." end
	end
	-- Additive field in the current envelope: older saves seed their owned flock.
	-- Discovery survives sale/merge; an unbought roll offer never adds an entry.
	local discovered = {}
	if data.discovered ~= nil then
		if type(data.discovered) ~= "table" then return false,"Invalid saved chicken index." end
		for species, collected in data.discovered do
			if type(species) ~= "string" or not table.find(Catalog.Order, species) or type(collected) ~= "boolean" then
				return false,"Invalid saved chicken index."
			end
			if collected then discovered[species] = true end
		end
	end
	for _, pet in pets do discovered[pet.species] = true end
	if not numberIn(data.coins+converted,0,1e12) then return false,"Saved coin balance exceeds the supported limit." end
	local wins=readProgress(data,revision)
	if not wins then return false,"Invalid saved camp progress." end
 local frontier,king={},false
 if revision>=6 then
  frontier=readWins(data.frontierWins,#Progression.Outposts(),true)
  if not frontier or type(data.kingCleared)~="boolean" then return false,"Invalid saved exploration progress." end
  king=data.kingCleared
 elseif revision==5 then
  -- Preserve completed older stages as distinct outposts; never downgrade an earned tier.
  local old=readWins(data.firstWins,3)
  for tier=2,4 do
   local offset=(tier-2)*2
   if promotion>tier then frontier[offset+1],frontier[offset+2]=true,true
   elseif promotion==tier then
    if old[1] then frontier[offset+1]=true end
    if old[3] then frontier[offset+2]=true end
   end
  end
 end
 -- Older migrations earned ranks after two retained route camps. Preserve that
 -- entitlement without treating their old third landmark as Bucket Bastion.
 -- Current revision-6 profiles keep their saved rank; new unlocks need all camps.
 if revision<6 and wins[1] and wins[2] then
  local previousEarned=if frontier[4] then 4 elseif frontier[2] then 3 else 2
  if previousEarned>promotion then promotion,recruitTier=previousEarned,previousEarned end
 end
	local tutorial={}
	for _,key in {"rolled","bought","collected","collectedEggs","soldEggs","wonCamp","returned","upgraded"} do tutorial[key]=data.tutorial[key]==true end
	if not numberIn(data.passiveEarned or 0,0,1e12) or not numberIn(data.battleEarned or 0,0,1e12) then return false,"Invalid saved earnings." end
	-- Commit only after every field validates. Old egg values were already valued;
	-- never multiply them again, and omit them from the current save payload.
	self.purchaseReceipts,self.crateCredits,self.commerceAutomatic=receipts,data.crateCredits or 0,automatic
	self.guaranteedLuckRolls=(data.guaranteedLuckRolls or 0)%(ShopCatalog.GuaranteedLuck.interval*#ShopCatalog.GuaranteedLuck.sequence)
	self.dataRevision,self.legacyCapacityGrant=Config.DataRevision,grant
	self.eggSpeedLevel,self.plotSizeLevel,self.rollSlotsUnlocked=eggSpeedLevel,plotSizeLevel,rollSlotsUnlocked
	self.eggCarry={count=carry.count,value=carry.value};self.enemyKills=data.enemyKills or 0
	self.eggProcessor=processor
	self.offlineCash,self.offlineCashReceipt=offlineCash,nil
	-- Preserve saved ranks and validation; always use the best earned odds now.
	self.promotion,self.recruitTier=promotion,promotion
 self.frontierWins,self.kingCleared=frontier,king
	-- Preserve old saves: round any historical cents up once, never reset progress.
	self.coins,self.capacity,self.luck,self.incomeLevel=math.ceil(data.coins+converted),capacity,data.luck,data.incomeLevel
	self.pets,self.slots,self.firstWins,self.tutorial=pets,{},wins,tutorial
	self.armySelection=armySelection
	self.discovered = discovered
	self.passiveEarned,self.battleEarned=math.ceil(data.passiveEarned or 0),math.ceil(data.battleEarned or 0)
	self.armyState,self.outgoing,self.incoming,self.defending="Home",nil,nil,nil
	self.returnAt,self.stationedAt=0,nil
	self.campUnlocked=1
	while self.firstWins[self.campUnlocked] and self.campUnlocked<#Progression.Camps(1) do self.campUnlocked+=1 end
	self.offer,self.offers=nil,{}
	self:RetireEggSeller()
	self:UnlockProgress();self:RefreshArmy();self:Touch()
	return true,if legacy then "Loaded and converted stored egg value to coins." else "Loaded."
end

function PlayerSession:Destroy()
	self.pets, self.slots = {}, {}
end

return PlayerSession

--!strict
-- Sole developer-product receipt owner. Prompt-finished events never grant items.
local MarketplaceService=game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ShopCatalog=require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared.ShopCatalog)
local EggProcessor=require(script.Parent.EggProcessor)
local ProductService={}
ProductService.__index=ProductService
local Granted=Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
local Pending=Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
local Owners=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
local MaxCoins=1e12
local MaxCrates=1e9

local function integer(value,minimum,maximum)
 return type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=minimum and value<=maximum and value%1==0
end

function ProductService.new(dataService,sessions,dependencies)
 dependencies=dependencies or {}
 local self=setmetatable({data=dataService,sessions=sessions,
  marketplace=dependencies.marketplace or MarketplaceService,
  players=dependencies.players or Players,catalog=dependencies.catalog or ShopCatalog,
  wait=dependencies.wait or task.wait,monotonic=dependencies.monotonic or os.clock,
  products={},destroyed=false,started=false},ProductService)
 for _,key in self.catalog.ProductOrder do
  local product=self.catalog.Products[key]
  assert(product and integer(product.productId,1,2^53-1),"Invalid developer product: "..key)
  assert(not self.products[product.productId],"Duplicate developer product ID")
  self.products[product.productId]=product
 end
 return self
end

function ProductService:CanPurchase(session)
 if self.destroyed or not session or self.sessions[session.userId]~=session then return false,"Shop unavailable." end
 local player=self.players:GetPlayerByUserId(session.userId)
 if not player or player.Parent==nil then return false,"Player is no longer here." end
 return self.data:CanPurchase(session)
end

function ProductService:_WaitForSession(userId)
 -- Redelivery can race PlayerAdded/profile loading. Roblox does not retry on a
 -- timer, so briefly await the existing load instead of requiring another rejoin.
 local deadline=self.monotonic()+20
 while not self.destroyed do
  local player=self.players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
  if not player or player.Parent==nil then return nil end
  local session=self.sessions[userId]
  if session then
   if session.closing or session.saveLost then return nil end
   if session.loaded then return session end
   if session.saveStatus=="error" then return nil end
  end
  if self.monotonic()>=deadline then return nil end
  self.wait(0.1)
 end
 return nil
end

function ProductService:_ProcessReceipt(receipt)
 if self.destroyed or type(receipt)~="table" or not integer(receipt.PlayerId,1,2^53-1)
  or not integer(receipt.ProductId,1,2^53-1) or type(receipt.PurchaseId)~="string"
  or #receipt.PurchaseId<1 or #receipt.PurchaseId>256 or not utf8.len(receipt.PurchaseId) then return Pending end
 local session=self:_WaitForSession(receipt.PlayerId)
 if not self:CanPurchase(session) then return Pending end
 -- An already delivered discontinued product remains acknowledgeable.
 if self.data:IsPurchaseSaved(session,receipt.PurchaseId,receipt.ProductId) then return Granted end
 local product=self.products[receipt.ProductId]
 if not product then return Pending end
 local saved=self.data:CommitPurchase(session,receipt.PurchaseId,receipt.ProductId,function()
  -- This function must not yield. Recheck presence after waiting for an autosave.
  if not self:CanPurchase(session) then return false,"The player left during delivery." end
  if product.finishEggs==true then
   if not EggProcessor.GrantFinish(session.eggProcessor) then return false end
   session:RetireEggSeller()
   return true
  elseif product.coins~=nil and product.crates==nil and integer(product.coins,1,MaxCoins)
   and integer(session.coins,0,MaxCoins-product.coins) then
   -- Exact purchased amount: earned-income passes never multiply paid currency.
   session.coins+=product.coins
  elseif product.crates~=nil and product.coins==nil and integer(product.crates,1,MaxCrates)
   and integer(session.crateCredits,0,MaxCrates-product.crates) then
   session.crateCredits+=product.crates
  else
   return false,"This purchase cannot fit safely yet. Spend or open items, then rejoin."
  end
  return true
 end)
 return if saved then Granted else Pending
end

function ProductService:ProcessReceipt(receipt)
 local ok,decision=pcall(function() return self:_ProcessReceipt(receipt) end)
 if not ok then
  warn("[PetRoll] Product delivery deferred: "..tostring(decision))
  return Pending
 end
 return decision
end

function ProductService:Start()
 if self.destroyed then return false,"Product service is closed." end
 if self.started then return true end
 if Owners[self.marketplace] and Owners[self.marketplace]~=self then return false,"A receipt handler already exists." end
 Owners[self.marketplace]=self
 self.marketplace.ProcessReceipt=function(receipt) return self:ProcessReceipt(receipt) end
 self.started=true
 return true
end

function ProductService:Destroy()
 if self.destroyed then return end
 self.destroyed=true
 if Owners[self.marketplace]==self then
  -- Callback members are write-only in Roblox; keep a safe handler during teardown.
  self.marketplace.ProcessReceipt=function() return Pending end
  Owners[self.marketplace]=nil
 end
 self.started=false
end

return ProductService

--!strict
-- Roblox owns pass persistence. This service holds only verified session benefits;
-- client refresh requests and purchase-finished booleans never grant ownership.
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local PolicyService = game:GetService("PolicyService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Rules = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared.Rules)
local ShopCatalog = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").PetRoll.Shared.ShopCatalog)
local CommerceService = {}
CommerceService.__index = CommerceService
local RefreshSeconds = 8
local AutomaticRetries = 2

local function configured(id)
	return type(id) == "number" and id > 0 and id < math.huge and id % 1 == 0
end

-- Dependencies are injectable for isolated checks; production uses Roblox APIs.
function CommerceService.new(dependencies)
	dependencies = dependencies or {}
	local self = setmetatable({
		marketplace = dependencies.marketplace or MarketplaceService,
		policy = dependencies.policy or PolicyService,
		catalog = dependencies.catalog or ShopCatalog,
		clock = dependencies.clock or os.clock,
		delay = dependencies.delay or task.delay,
		records = {}, destroyed = false,
	}, CommerceService)
	self.connection = self.marketplace.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, _wasPurchased)
		self:_PurchaseFinished(player, passId)
	end)
	return self
end

function CommerceService:_Active(record)
	return not self.destroyed and self.records[record.player.UserId] == record
		and not record.session.closing and not record.session.saveLost
		and record.player.Parent ~= nil
end

function CommerceService:_ScheduleRefresh(record)
	if not self:_Active(record) or record.busy or record.scheduled or not (record.pending or record.retryPending) then return end
	record.scheduled = true
	self.delay(math.max(0, record.nextAt - self.clock()), function()
		record.scheduled = false
		if not self:_Active(record) then return end
		-- A manual check may have satisfied this work or moved its throttle window.
		if record.busy or not (record.pending or record.retryPending) then return end
		if self.clock() < record.nextAt then self:_ScheduleRefresh(record); return end
		local freshCycle = record.pending
		record.pending, record.retryPending = false, false
		self:_Refresh(record.player, record.session, freshCycle)
	end)
end

function CommerceService:_PurchaseFinished(player, passId)
	if not configured(passId) then return end
	local record = self.records[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.player ~= player or not self:_Active(record) then return end
	for _, key in self.catalog.Order do
		if self.catalog.Definitions[key].passId == passId then
			-- Also safe on cancellation: only a fresh ownership check can enable it.
			record.pending = true
			self:_ScheduleRefresh(record)
			return
		end
	end
end

function CommerceService:Load(player, session)
	if self.destroyed or session.userId ~= player.UserId or session.closing or session.saveLost or player.Parent == nil then
		return false, "Shop unavailable."
	end
	local existing = self.records[player.UserId]
	if existing and existing.player == player and existing.session == session then
		return self:Refresh(player, session)
	end
	if existing then self:Release(existing.player) end
	local owned = {}
	for _, key in self.catalog.Order do owned[key] = false end
	local record = {player = player, session = session, owned = owned,
		ready = false, busy = false, nextAt = -math.huge, pending = false, scheduled = false,
		retryPending = false, retriesLeft = 0}
	self.records[player.UserId] = record
	session.entitlements = owned
	player:SetAttribute("PetRollCommanderBanner", false)
	return self:Refresh(player, session)
end

function CommerceService:Refresh(player, session)
	return self:_Refresh(player, session, true)
end

function CommerceService:TestAllowed(session)
	return RunService:IsStudio() and session.saveStatus == "studio-session"
		and session.loaded == true and not session.closing and not session.saveLost
end

-- Overrides never alter verified ownership or serialize into a player profile.
-- Reapply after every yielding marketplace refresh so it cannot restore paid perks.
function CommerceService:_ApplyBenefits(record)
	local session = record.session
	local preset = if self:TestAllowed(session) then record.testPreset else nil
	session.commerceTestPreset = preset
	local owned = table.clone(record.owned)
	if preset then
		for _, key in self.catalog.Order do
			owned[key] = preset == "AllPasses" or (preset == "EggSpawn" and key == "DoubleEggSpawn")
		end
	end
	session.entitlements = owned
	record.player:SetAttribute("PetRollCommanderBanner", owned.CommanderBanner == true)
	session:RefreshArmy()
	session:Touch()
end

function CommerceService:SetTestPreset(player, session, preset)
	if not self:TestAllowed(session) then return false, "Use a disposable Studio session for purchase testing." end
	if preset ~= "Account" and preset ~= "NoPasses" and preset ~= "EggSpawn" and preset ~= "AllPasses" then
		return false, "Choose a valid purchase test preset."
	end
	local record = self.records[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.session ~= session or not self:_Active(record) then return false, "Wait for the shop to load." end
	record.testPreset = if preset == "Account" then nil else preset
	self:_ApplyBenefits(record)
	return true, "TEST: " .. preset .. " benefits. Real purchases are unchanged."
end

function CommerceService:_Refresh(player, session, freshCycle)
	local record = self.records[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.player ~= player or record.session ~= session or not self:_Active(record) then
		return false, "Shop unavailable."
	end
	if record.busy then return false, "Checking passes…" end
	if self.clock() < record.nextAt then
		return record.ready, if record.ready then "Passes checked." else "Please try again in a moment."
	end
	-- Only accepted external checks reset the budget. Automatic retries enter this
	-- private path with false, so an outage cannot create an endless polling loop.
	if freshCycle then
		record.retriesLeft = AutomaticRetries
		record.pending, record.retryPending = false, false
	end
	record.busy, record.ready = true, false
	record.nextAt = self.clock() + RefreshSeconds
	local policyOk,policyInfo=pcall(function() return self.policy:GetPolicyInfoForPlayerAsync(player) end)
	if not self:_Active(record) then record.busy=false;return false,"Shop unavailable." end
	record.policyReady=policyOk and type(policyInfo)=="table" and type(policyInfo.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted)=="boolean"
	record.paidRandomAllowed=record.policyReady and policyInfo.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted==false
	session.paidRandomAllowed=record.paidRandomAllowed
	session.paidRandomRestricted=record.policyReady and policyInfo.ArePaidRandomItemsRestricted==true
	local allChecked = true
	for _, key in self.catalog.Order do
		local passId = self.catalog.Definitions[key].passId
		if not configured(passId) then
			record.owned[key] = false
		else
			local ok, owns = pcall(function()
				return self.marketplace:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, passId)
			end)
			-- A player can leave, reload or lose the profile lease during this yield.
			if not self:_Active(record) then record.busy = false; return false, "Shop unavailable." end
			if ok and type(owns) == "boolean" then
				record.owned[key] = owns
			else
				-- Preserve a previously verified benefit during a transient API failure.
				-- First-time failures remain false because Load initialized every key.
				allChecked = false
			end
		end
	end
	if not self:_Active(record) then record.busy = false; return false, "Shop unavailable." end
	record.busy, record.ready = false, allChecked
	self:_ApplyBenefits(record)
	local fullyChecked=allChecked and record.policyReady==true
	if fullyChecked then
		record.retriesLeft, record.retryPending = 0, false
	elseif record.retriesLeft > 0 then
		record.retriesLeft -= 1
		record.retryPending = true
	end
	self:_ScheduleRefresh(record)
	return fullyChecked, if fullyChecked then "Passes checked." else "Couldn't check every shop benefit. Retrying shortly."
end

function CommerceService:Snapshot(session)
	local record = self.records[session.userId]
	local owned = {}
	local active = record and record.session == session and self:_Active(record)
	for _, key in self.catalog.Order do owned[key] = active and session.entitlements[key] == true or false end
	local testing = active and self:TestAllowed(session)
	return {owned = owned, ready = active and (record.ready == true or record.testPreset ~= nil) or false,
		testAllowed = testing == true, testPreset = if testing then record.testPreset or "Account" else nil,
		checking = active and (record.busy or record.scheduled) == true or false,
		automatic=table.clone(session.commerceAutomatic),crateCredits=session.crateCredits,
		policyReady=active and record.policyReady==true or false,
		paidRandomAllowed=active and record.paidRandomAllowed==true or false,
		restrictedTreatment=self.catalog.RestrictedTreatment,luckGuarantee=session:LuckGuarantee(),
		luckOdds={withoutPass=Rules.Odds(session.luck,session.recruitTier,1),withPass=Rules.Odds(session.luck,session.recruitTier,2)}}
end

function CommerceService:SetAutomatic(session,key,enabled)
 local definition=if type(key)=="string" then self.catalog.Definitions[key] else nil
 if not definition or definition.enabled==false or not definition.automatic or type(enabled)~="boolean" or session.entitlements[key]~=true then
  return false,"You need that pass to change its setting."
 end
 session.commerceAutomatic[key]=enabled
 session:Touch()
 return true,definition.name..(if enabled then " on." else " off.")
end

function CommerceService:PreparePurchase(player,session,key,productReady)
 if self:TestAllowed(session) then return false,"Studio session: use F8 purchase presets; checkout is disabled." end
 if type(key)~="string" or #key>48 then return false,"Unknown shop item." end
 local definition=self.catalog.Definitions[key] or self.catalog.Products[key]
 local record=self.records[player.UserId]
 if not definition or definition.enabled==false or not record or record.session~=session or not self:_Active(record) then return false,"Shop unavailable." end
 if definition.passId then
  if not record.ready then return false,"Please wait while passes are checked." end
  if record.owned[key] then return false,"You already own this pass." end
 elseif not productReady then return false,"Purchases need a safely loaded, saved profile." end
 if definition.coins and session.coins>1e12-definition.coins then return false,"Spend some coins before buying this pack." end
 if definition.crates and session.crateCredits>1e9-definition.crates then return false,"Open some crates before buying more." end
 if definition.crates and not self.catalog.Crate.enabled then return false,"Crate rewards are being prepared." end
 if definition.paidRandom then
  if not record.policyReady then return false,"Please wait while purchase availability is checked." end
  local guaranteed=key=="DoubleLuck" and self.catalog.RestrictedTreatment=="GuaranteedOffers"
  if not record.paidRandomAllowed and not guaranteed then return false,"This random purchase is unavailable for your account." end
 end
 return true,"",{key=key,kind=if definition.passId then "Pass" else "Product",id=definition.passId or definition.productId}
end

function CommerceService:Release(player)
	local record = self.records[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.player ~= player then return end
	self.records[player.UserId] = nil
	record.session.entitlements = {}
	record.session.commerceTestPreset = nil
	record.session.paidRandomAllowed=false
	record.session.paidRandomRestricted=false
	player:SetAttribute("PetRollCommanderBanner", false)
end

function CommerceService:Destroy()
	self.destroyed = true
	if self.connection then self.connection:Disconnect(); self.connection = nil end
	for _, record in self.records do self:Release(record.player) end
end

return CommerceService

function GameServer:Send(player,result)
	local session=self.sessions[player.UserId]
	if not session then return end
	local now=os.clock()
	local state=session:Snapshot(now)
	state.boardUpgrades=self.upgrades:Offers(session)
 local routeCamps,routeOutposts=self.battles:RouteProgress(session)
 state.routeCamps,state.routeOutposts=table.clone(routeCamps),table.clone(routeOutposts)
 local kingOwner=self.battles.campOwners["king:1"]
 state.ownsKing=kingOwner~=nil and kingOwner.userId==session.userId
 state.routeCampsWon=0
 for i=1,#Progression.Camps(1) do if routeCamps[i] then state.routeCampsWon+=1 end end
	state.eggs=self.eggs:Snapshot(session,now)

	state.mergeOptions=ArmyService.MergeOptions(session)
	local battle=self.battles.battles[session.outgoing]
	state.travelStage=if battle and battle.phase=="Travel" then (if battle.assembling then "Assembling" else "Marching") else nil
	state.recoveringCount,state.reinforcingCount=0,0
	local side=if battle and battle.defender==session.userId then "B" else "A"
	if battle then for _,unit in battle.units do if unit.side==side and not unit.retiring then
		if unit.hp<=0 then state.recoveringCount+=1 elseif unit.reinforcing then state.reinforcingCount+=1 end
	end end end
	state.marchingTo=if battle and battle.phase=="Travel" then battle.name else nil
	state.routeGoal=if battle and battle.routeGoal then battle.routeGoalName else nil
	state.debugAllowed=DebugService.Allowed(player)
	self.remotes.StateChanged:FireClient(player,{state=state,result=result})
end

	elseif action=="BoardUpgrade" then

function GameServer:AddPlayer(player)
	if self.sessions[player.UserId] then return end
	local used={}
	for _,session in self.sessions do used[session.plotIndex]=true end

		local bot=self.sessions[-999];index=bot.plotIndex
		self.battles:CancelPlayer(bot.userId,os.clock());self.world:Release(bot);bot:Destroy();self.sessions[-999]=nil
	end
	if not index then player:Kick("All plots are full. Please join another server.");return end
	local session=PlayerSession.new(player.UserId,player.DisplayName,index)

		local root=character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)

		end
	end
	self.playerConnections[player.UserId]=player.CharacterAdded:Connect(spawn)
	if player.Character then task.spawn(spawn,player.Character) end
	self.world:UpdateSession(session)
 local testMode=workspace:GetAttribute("PetRollAcceptanceMode")==true
  or (RunService:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute("PetRollPlaytestSessionOnly")==true)
 local unpublished=RunService:IsStudio() and game.GameId==0
 if testMode or unpublished or not Config.SaveEnabled then
  session.loaded=true;session.saveStatus="studio-session";session.saveMessage=if unpublished then "Unsaved local file: session only. Use Pet Roll Test for saved progress." else "Isolated test session; your saved flock is untouched."
 else

function GameServer:RemovePlayer(player)
 local session=self.sessions[player.UserId]
 if not session or session.closing then return end
 session.closing=true
 self.commerce:Release(player)

 self.eggs:Release(session)
 self.leaderboards:Write(session)

 self.sessions[player.UserId],self.limits[player.UserId]=nil,nil
 local connection=self.playerConnections[player.UserId]
 if connection then connection:Disconnect();self.playerConnections[player.UserId]=nil end
 self.data:Release(session)
 self.telemetry:Release(player.UserId)
 self.recruitObservations[player.UserId],self.awayObservations[player.UserId]=nil,nil
 session:Destroy()
end

-- Session-local observation of confirmed server state; no gameplay decisions or external analytics.
function GameServer:ObserveLoop(dt,now)
 for id,session in self.sessions do
  if not session.loaded or session.closing or session.saveLost then continue end
  local away=self.awayObservations[id]
  if session.armyState~="Home" then
   if not away then away={at=now,lost=0};self.awayObservations[id]=away end
   local rate=0;for petId in session.pets do if not session:IsPetHome(petId) then rate+=session:PetIncome(petId) end end
   away.lost+=rate*dt
  elseif away then
   self.telemetry:Record("ArmyReturned",{userId=id,seconds=now-away.at,foregoneEggValue=math.floor(away.lost),estimated=true})
   self.awayObservations[id]=nil
  end
  local pending=self.recruitObservations[id]
  if not pending then continue end
  for petId,intent in pending do if now-intent.at>600 or not session.pets[petId] then pending[petId]=nil end end
  local battle=self.battles.battles[session.outgoing]
  if not battle or (battle.phase~="Fight" and battle.phase~="Capture" and battle.phase~="Holding") then continue end
  local side=if battle.attacker==id then "A" else "B"
  for _,unit in battle.units do
   local intent=unit.petId and pending[unit.petId]
   if intent and unit.side==side and unit.hp>0 and not unit.reinforcing and not unit.retiring and battle:ReachedCamp(unit) then
    self.telemetry:Record("RecruitArrived",{userId=id,assignment=intent.assignment,seconds=now-intent.at,
     kind=if battle.incomeSite then "Income" else "Conquest"},"recruit:"..unit.petId)
    pending[unit.petId]=nil
   end
  end
 end
end

function GameServer:Step(dt)
	local now=os.clock()
	if Config.Features.Merging and now>=(self.nextAutomaticAt or 0) then
		self.nextAutomaticAt=now+1
		for _,session in self.sessions do
			if session.loaded and not session.closing and not session.saveLost then ArmyService.AutoMerge(session) end
		end
	end
	self.world:Step(now)
 self.leaderboards:Step(now)
 self.data:Step()
	self.stepAccumulator+=dt
	self.snapshotAccumulator+=dt
	local steps=0
	while self.stepAccumulator>=Config.BattleStep and steps<10 do
		self.stepAccumulator-=Config.BattleStep;steps+=1
		self.battles:Step(Config.BattleStep,now-self.stepAccumulator)
		self.eggs:Step(self.sessions,Config.BattleStep,now-self.stepAccumulator)
  self:ObserveLoop(Config.BattleStep,now-self.stepAccumulator)
	end
	if self.snapshotAccumulator>=Config.SnapshotInterval then
		self.snapshotAccumulator=0
		for _,session in self.sessions do self.world:UpdateSession(session) end
		for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do self:Send(player) end
		self.remotes.BattleChanged:FireAllClients(self.battles:Snapshots(now))
	end
end

function GameServer:Start()
	assert(not self.started,"GameServer already started")
	self.started=true
	assert(self.products:Start(),"Could not initialize purchase delivery")
	self.world:Build()
	self.upgrades:Start()
	self.leaderboards:Build()
	local folder=ReplicatedStorage.PetRoll:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if not folder then folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="Remotes";folder.Parent=ReplicatedStorage.PetRoll end
	for _,name in {"RequestAction","StateChanged","BattleChanged"} do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then local remote=Instance.new("RemoteEvent");remote.Name=name;remote.Parent=folder end
	end
	self.remotes=folder
	self.world.onAction=function(player,action,index,offerId)
		self:Handle(player,{action=action,id=0,stationIndex=index,offerId=offerId})
	end
	table.insert(self.connections,folder.RequestAction.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,request) self:Handle(player,request) end))
	table.insert(self.connections,Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) self:AddPlayer(player) end))
	table.insert(self.connections,Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:RemovePlayer(player) end))
	for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do task.spawn(function() self:AddPlayer(player) end) end
	table.insert(self.connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) self:Step(dt) end))
	game:BindToClose(function()
  for _,session in self.sessions do session.closing=true;self.eggs:Release(session) end
  for _,session in self.sessions do task.spawn(function() self.leaderboards:Write(session) end) end
  self.data:Close()
 end)
 print("[PetRoll] My Chicken Army! "..Config.Version.." ready. Yard chickens lay eggs; collect them for coins.")
end

function GameServer:Destroy()
	for _,session in self.sessions do session.closing=true;self.eggs:Release(session) end
	for _,connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	for _,connection in self.playerConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
	self.products:Destroy();self.leaderboards:Destroy();self.commerce:Destroy();self.eggs:Destroy();self.battles:Destroy();self.world:Destroy()
	self.telemetry:Destroy()
 table.clear(self.recruitObservations);table.clear(self.awayObservations)
	self.started=false
end

return GameServer

--!strict

local function padTween(view, key, seconds, goals, instant, repeats)
	if view[key] then view[key]:Cancel(); view[key]:Destroy(); view[key]=nil end
	if instant then
		for property,value in goals do view.pad[property]=value end

function Board.new(app)

function Board:Render()
	local state=self.app.state

		view.gui.Enabled=view.originalEnabled and offer~=nil and offer.enabled and view.index==state.plotIndex

			self.groundRay.FilterDescendantsInstances={root.Parent}
			self.groundRay.CollisionGroup=root.CollisionGroup
			local reach=humanoid.HipHeight+root.Size.Y/2+2.5 -- Includes R6 leg height.
			local hit=workspace:Raycast(root.Position,Vector3.new(0,-reach,0),self.groundRay)
			pressed=hit~=nil and hit.Instance==view.pad
		end
	end
	if view.pressed~=pressed or view.reduced~=reduced then
		view.pressed=pressed
		local frame=if pressed then view.padFrame+Vector3.new(0,-PAD_PRESS_DEPTH,0) else view.padFrame
		padTween(view,"pressTween",if pressed then PAD_STEP_SECONDS else PAD_RELEASE_SECONDS,{CFrame=frame},reduced,pressed)
	end
	view.reduced=reduced
end

function Board:Receive(_result)
	self:Render()
end

function Board:Start()
	self.playerGui=Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	table.insert(self.connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local character=Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		for _,view in self.views do self:UpdatePad(view,root,humanoid) end
	end))
	table.insert(self.connections,workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
		if item:IsA("SurfaceGui") or item.Name=="EggSellingBoard" or item.Name=="ReadyCash" then
			task.defer(function()
				local source=if item:IsA("SurfaceGui") then item else item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
				if source then self:Bind(source) end
			end)
		end
	end))
	local world=workspace:FindFirstChild("PetRollWorld")
	if world then for _,item in world:GetDescendants() do if item:IsA("SurfaceGui") then self:Bind(item) end end end
end

function Board:Destroy()
	self.alive=false
	for _,connection in self.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	local sources={}
	for source in self.views do table.insert(sources,source) end
	for _,source in sources do self:Unbind(source) end
end

return Board
